# Invoice Discrepancy and Exceptional Case Handling

This document provides guidelines on managing invoice discrepancies and exceptional situations to complement the 'pay first, collect later' policy.

## Handling Invoice Discrepancies
- Promptly review any discrepancies between the invoice and the supporting documents.
- Communicate with the vendor or internal department to resolve discrepancies within a reasonable timeframe.
- Document all communications and resolutions for audit purposes.

## Exceptional Cases
- For urgent payments where documents are missing or incomplete, proceed with payment approval cautiously.
- Escalate to management if discrepancies cannot be resolved promptly.
- Implement temporary controls or holdbacks if necessary until full documentation is received.

## Record Keeping
- Maintain clear records of all invoices, approvals, discrepancies, and resolutions.
- Ensure compliance with company policies and audit requirements.

This guideline supports the operational integrity of the invoice approval process under the new policy.
